description: Screenshot of an Instagram post from the account antwiththecuts. The main photo shows a pickup-truck bed loaded with cases of bottled water, blue fluid jugs, boxed fire extinguishers and a produce box in a parking lot under a smoky orange sky; thumbnails above show a charred, hazy landscape and a man eating at a restaurant. The caption, highlighted in yellow, claims the poster is 'Heading back out to clack and estacada to set some fires!!!' with 2020 Oregon wildfire hashtags, and a commenter replies 'Gas cans. Nice.' The screenshot circulated as purported evidence of arson during the September 2020 Oregon wildfires; the claim is unverified and the caption may be a joke or boast.

description: Screenshot of the top of a news article headlined 'Victoria's Secret reportedly continued to work with a modelling agency after it was accused of supplying underage girls to Jeffrey Epstein,' bylined Mary Hanbury, July 30, 2019; the layout and byline are consistent with Business Insider, though no outlet logo is visible. Two side-by-side photos show Les Wexner (left, in a tuxedo at a step-and-repeat) and Jeffrey Epstein (right, in a dark zip jacket). The headline's allegation about the modelling agency is the article's reported claim.
